text.div: MedFlow Guardian supports a constrained FHIR R4 export, Consent-import, and protected Binary-read interface. It is not a general FHIR CRUD server.

name: MedFlowGuardianR4CapabilityStatement
title: MedFlow Guardian FHIR R4 Capability Statement
description: FHIR R4 export, Consent-import, and protected Binary-read capabilities implemented by MedFlow. This is not a general-purpose FHIR CRUD server.

rest.documentation: Capability metadata is public. Patient export and Binary read require MedFlow bearer authentication and central authorization. Consent import uses the custom /fhir/consents/import endpoint. No standard FHIR search, history, update, delete, transaction, or batch endpoint is claimed.

security.description: MedFlow bearer JWT plus role, organization, relationship, consent, purpose, operation, time, and malware-release checks. CORS uses explicit trusted origins.

resource.documentation: Collection Bundle returned by the authorized patient export operation.
Export-only patient representation inside an authorized Bundle.
Referenced/exported practitioner identity; no standalone CRUD endpoint.
Referenced/exported organization identity; no standalone FHIR CRUD endpoint.
A fail-closed R4 subset is accepted only at the documented custom import endpoint.
Export-only prescription representation inside a Bundle.
Export-only laboratory result representation inside a Bundle.

Exported clinical-note or protected-document metadata. Private object-store locations are never disclosed; authorized document bytes are available only through the separately authorized FHIR Binary read endpoint.

Read-only protected document bytes. Release requires MedFlow authentication, central Model-A authorization, purpose/consent where applicable, and a clean malware-scan state. Storage keys and direct object URLs are never returned.
